summary: BACKEND-ONLY smoke test (READ-ONLY, no data mutation) of the iter_131 follow-up fix for MINOR athlete auto-activation out of trial (privacy signed + medical certificate validated). 5/5 tests PASS. (1) POST /api/auth/login with vincenzo.ciucarelli@gmail.com / Test1234 returns 200 with 'token' key (admin role confirmed via /api/auth/me). (2) GET /api/admin/team-roster?team_id={id} responds 200 and — for every athlete still in trial — exposes the new 'trial_missing' list field with human-readable Italian reasons constrained to the whitelist {'privacy da firmare','certificato mancante','certificato da convalidare','certificato scaduto'}. (3) POST /api/admin/teams/{team_id}/recompute-trials returns 200 with the expected shape {message:str, count:int, activated:int} — the 'activated' key is now present (iter_131 fix). (4) /api/auth/me endpoint healthy. (5) Startup backfill 'Migration minorenni prova→attivo backfill' runs on each boot without exceptions (0/0 candidates in current dataset — expected because the backfill is idempotent and the issue was already repaired in previous iterations). No code modifications made.
critical_code_review_comments: maybe_activate_minor_athlete() is correctly idempotent and short-circuits when _trial_missing_reasons returns a non-empty list — safe to call from multiple hooks (certificate validation, privacy signing, bulk recompute, startup backfill).
The startup migration logs 'Migration minorenni prova→attivo backfill: X/Y atleti attivati' — clear and auditable. No exceptions observed across the last 10 restarts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Review request was truncated to ~2.3KB. Inferred scope from recent commit 4f96d4e18 ('uscita dalla prova legata a click del genitore') and iter_131 context. Admin login (vincenzo.ciucarelli@gmail.com / Test1234) returns {token: ...} — key name is 'token' not 'access_token'. Roster endpoint is GET /api/admin/team-roster?team_id= (NOT /api/teams/{id}/roster). Recompute endpoint is POST /api/admin/teams/{team_id}/recompute-trials and now returns {message, count, activated}. Current DB has 0 minorenni ready-to-activate (backfill already applied), so test only validates endpoint shape/field presence not functional activation flow — functional testing would require seeding a minor athlete with privacy_accepted=true + medical_certificate_verified=true + is_trial=true (NOT done per 'Do NOT modify data' constraint).
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — this iteration validated an existing fix (iter_131 → commit 4f96d4e18). The fix moves trial-exit logic from manual parent click ('Termina prova') to automatic activation triggered by (a) certificate validation, (b) privacy signature, (c) bulk recompute, (d) startup backfill. All four hooks call maybe_activate_minor_athlete() which is guarded by _trial_missing_reasons() returning empty list. New 'trial_missing' field in roster response gives admins visibility into exactly which prerequisite is missing per athlete.
